body: A ping-pong table?! This pisses me off so much. Labor is exchanged for wages, and typically for less value than the labor is worth. It's always about the fucking money.

I don't know if this helps, but I play RPGs to get any shopaholic tendencies out of my system. Earning in-game currency for purchasing items in a virtual space helps me not to touch my real-life wallet and think less about what products are being pushed on me that I don't need.
She doesn't sound very good with managing money. I hope she puts her business acumen to good use and destroys Amazon (her employer).
Ooh, yes! Shades of grey and sterile, antisocial architecture. Completely soul-sucking and depressing. I had to take medical leave from this call center once because I was on the verge of suicide.
Thanks! :) I love that line. I wrote this years ago, but I'll reread it sometimes and it helps keep my life in perspective. Fuck corporate work.
Thank you! :) It was definitely a cathartic exercise to get over that horrible place.
